title: The Autopsy of Little Hawley
author: Jonah Sandoval
blurb: Cyrus Okafor, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
